LanguageData.LP_AC_ChainLightning.label: chain lightning
LanguageData.LP_AC_ChainLightning.description: Universal arcanum (circle 6 spell, Intelligence): a bolt of lightning starts at the target and jumps across 4 enemies, each taking 25 electrical damage, ×1.5 against mechanoids. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_BladeBarrier.label: blade barrier
LanguageData.LP_AC_BladeBarrier.description: Universal arcanum (circle 6 spell, Wisdom): raise an 8-cell-long wall of whirling blades at the target for 1 hour; enemies on the wall take 20 cut damage per second and are slowed 50%. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Heal.label: heal
LanguageData.LP_AC_Heal.description: Universal arcanum (circle 6 spell, Wisdom): the target heals 70% of injuries (multiplied by power) and is cured of blindness, disease and food poisoning. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_FingerOfDeath.label: finger of death
LanguageData.LP_AC_FingerOfDeath.description: Universal arcanum (circle 7 spell, Charisma): 50 necrotic damage; humanlikes killed by it rise as undead servants of the caster's faction (permanent, no mental breaks). Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Regenerate.label: regenerate
LanguageData.LP_AC_Regenerate.description: Universal arcanum (circle 7 spell, Wisdom): instantly removes one of the target's old scars; after 3 days a lost limb or organ grows back. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_ReverseGravity.label: reverse gravity
LanguageData.LP_AC_ReverseGravity.description: Universal arcanum (circle 7 spell, Intelligence): enemies within radius 5 of the target fly up for 10 seconds, unable to move, and each take 20 blunt damage on landing. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Sunburst.label: sunburst
LanguageData.LP_AC_Sunburst.description: Universal arcanum (circle 8 spell, Wisdom): a blazing sunburst of radius 6 at a point within 30 cells: 45 holy burn damage and blinded for 1 minute; ×2 against undead. Allies are caught too (except the caster). Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_MindBlank.label: mind blank
LanguageData.LP_AC_MindBlank.description: Universal arcanum (circle 8 spell, Intelligence): the target is immune to mind control, charm, mental breaks and psychic damage for 1 day. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Maze.label: maze
LanguageData.LP_AC_Maze.description: Universal arcanum (circle 8 spell, Intelligence): banish an enemy to an otherworldly labyrinth for 30 seconds (it vanishes from the map, then returns to its spot); 10 seconds for legendary creatures. It's put back at once if the caster dies or the map unloads. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_TimeStop.label: time stop
LanguageData.LP_AC_TimeStop.description: Universal arcanum (circle 9 spell, Intelligence): everyone on this map except the caster, and projectiles in flight, freeze for 6 seconds (3 seconds for legendary creatures and story bosses); the caster harming someone makes time resume early. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_PowerWordKill.label: power word kill
LanguageData.LP_AC_PowerWordKill.description: Universal arcanum (circle 9 spell, Charisma): non-legendary creatures with remaining health ≤ 40% die on the spot; otherwise they take 40 psychic damage. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_Wish.label: wish
LanguageData.LP_AC_Wish.description: Universal arcanum (circle 9 spell, Charisma): open the wish window and pick a wish. Safe wishes: cast any universal arcanum spell of circle 8 or lower directly (including ones you haven't learned); fully heal all colonists on this map and cure their diseases; conjure items worth up to 3000 silver in total. Great wishes: revive 1 colonist dead no more than 30 days, +1 ability score permanently, or dispel a long-term event; these have a 33% chance to make the caster permanently lose Wish and be weakened for 10 days. Closing the window without choosing triggers no cooldown. Different from a genie lamp's wish. Cooldown 15 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_BoneBreak.label: bone-breaker strike
LanguageData.LP_AC_BoneBreak.description: Universal arcanum (circle 6 martial technique, Strength): within 1 hour, the next melee hit breaks one of the target's legs or arms (fracture for 10 days); legendary creatures take 30 blunt damage instead. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_SunArrow.label: sun-piercing arrow
LanguageData.LP_AC_SunArrow.description: Universal arcanum (circle 7 martial technique, Dexterity): one shot pierces in a straight line for 40 cells, every enemy along it takes 4× weapon damage; ranged weapons only. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_AC_TrueSight.label: true seeing
LanguageData.LP_AC_TrueSight.description: Universal arcanum passive (circle 7): invisible enemies within 30 cells are visible to you (revealed for 1 hour); immune to blindness and illusions.
LanguageData.LP_AC_ArcaneBulwark.label: arcane bulwark
LanguageData.LP_AC_ArcaneBulwark.description: Universal arcanum passive (circle 8): spell and psychic damage taken -40%, all save success +15%.
LanguageData.LP_AC_LegendaryResistance.label: legendary resistance
LanguageData.LP_AC_LegendaryResistance.description: Universal arcanum passive (circle 9): 3 times per day, turn a failed save into a success.
LanguageData.LP_AC_SecondHeart.label: second heart
LanguageData.LP_AC_SecondHeart.description: Universal arcanum passive (circle 9): once every 10 days, when you would die you're downed instead and stop bleeding (half the injuries healed).
